8178.title: Redundant validation in terminal send paths
8178.rootCauseOneLine: Daemon and server outbound terminal senders synchronously rescan base64 strings already produced locally or validated on receipt.

prReviews.verdict: Targets the verified cause (static review only)
prReviews.topFinding: The open closing PR addresses both outbound validation paths; its code and tests were not run.

8178.proposedFix: Narrowly bypass repeated outbound parsing for audited daemon terminal output/replay and server output, preserving incoming validation and other message parsing. Existing open PR 8179 prevents duplicate fix work.
8178.caveats: Node 22 timings differ from the reported Node 26 timings. The daemon probe is disconnected and isolates validation; no end-to-end PTY or browser measurement was performed. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent. Full reproduction source is inline; raw artifacts remain local under the reports repository publication policy.
